_provenance.source: h201:docker exec omnibase-infra-runtime-worker-1; inherited deployment environment; real _get_config() and packaged file hashes
command:
import hashlib,importlib.metadata,json,os,pathlib
from omnimarket.nodes.node_delegation_routing_reducer.handlers.handler_delegation_routing import _get_config
p=pathlib.Path(os.environ["DELEGATION_ROUTING_TIERS_PATH"])
d=importlib.metadata.distribution("omnimarket")
q=pathlib.Path(d.locate_file("omnimarket/configs/routing_tiers.yaml"))
a=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
b=hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert a == b
config=_get_config()
print(json.dumps({"tiers_path":str(p),"file_sha256":a,"packaged_sha256":b,"loader_type":type(config).__name__,"omnimarket_version":d.version,"runtime_profile":os.environ["RUNTIME_PROFILE"]}))
